news.body:
## Your last six working days at Locus
- Two open tasks need something from people there, and both get harder on 7 December.
Your x360 observers have to be entered by the 11th and the colleagues worth asking are at Locus. The KITAS termination letter has to come from Locus HR before Ascentium can start anything, and the NPWP revocation and the JHT claim both queue behind that one document. - You have handover conversations next week anyway, so put both asks into those rather than chasing a company you have left.
## Worth getting ahead of
- The P0 pre-reading has not moved since the 9th and it is dated 20 December.
Everything from the 3rd to the 11th is already booked, and you fly to Fontainebleau on 3 January. So the quiet stretch for reading is this weekend and next week’s evenings, not the week before Christmas.
